name: We Need Money
source:
You’re a young man on the brink of adulthood, drawn more to the thrills of city life and the company of girls than to books and lectures.
But your father has other plans: university is non-negotiable.

Forced to leave the city behind, you arrive in a small, quiet town where a newly opened university barely stirs any life. Everything feels unfamiliar — the streets, the people, the slow pace of life. You search desperately for a place to stay so you can continue your studies, but options are scarce… until you meet a young man named Rally, who offers you a small room to share in exchange for some cash.

It’s a simple arrangement at first — but in this sleepy town, nothing stays simple for long. Friendships, rivalries, and unexpected adventures await, in a place that seems quieter than it really is…
